'''Shreebirds''' were an endangered [[Species/Legends|species]]. [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] accidentally let loose numerous shreebirds from the [[Endangered Shreebird Aviary]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] at one point.<ref name="HNN" />
